integrity: Proof provides explicit extremizers and exact nuclear dual certificates; finite diagnostics are not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted adjacency-Dirac Connes distances only on finite complete bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two. This is not the shortest-path graph metric. Other graph Dirac operators and weighted bicliques are not covered. Full-text literature comparisons cannot exclude all earlier equivalent formulations; independent scientific validation is absent.
title: Complete-bipartite Connes distances from sharp operator–nuclear duality
